'''Combat''' was one of the two initial [[Regiment/Legends|regiments]], alongside [[Recon (SpecForces)|Recon]], that formed the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] when it was created. Over the course of several missions, SpecForce was reorganized into its more recognizable form of several smaller specialist units, such as [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrators]] or [[Wilderness Fighters]].<ref name="ROE" />
